args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money per FIN-212

The docstring claimed banker's rounding but the implementation used
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py to fail in the nightly build.
Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so half-cent values round to the nearest even cent.

args.head: fix/money-round-half-even
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` (per FIN-212) expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`), but `src/money.py` implemented `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring claiming otherwise.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: switch the `quantize` rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` (`2.675 → 2.68`, `2.665 → 2.66`).
